code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    def lines(axis):
        n = h if axis == 0 else w
        m = w if axis == 0 else h
        found = []
        for i in range(n):
            vals = [grid[i][j] if axis == 0 else grid[j][i] for j in range(m)]
            colors = [v for v in set(vals) if v != 0]
            if len(colors) == 1 and vals.count(colors[0]) >= m - 2:
                found.append(i)
        return found
    def sample(n, marks):
        out = []
        if not marks:
            return [0]
        out.append(0)
        for a, b in zip(marks, marks[1:]):
            out.extend([a, a + 1])
        out.append(marks[-1])
        out.append(n - 1)
        return sorted(set(out))
    rs = sample(h, lines(0))
    cs = sample(w, lines(1))
    return [[grid[r][c] for c in cs] for r in rs]
'''
